modules.title: HR Operations
modules.description: Learn how Human resource management plays a central role in creating healthy organizations and helping them survive. See how HR managers are responsible for all of the diverse issues associated with people in organizations.

modules.title: Recruitment and Selection
modules.description: Understand recruitment methods, workforce planning, employment practices, interviewing techniques, onboarding strategies.

modules.title: Compensation and Benefits
modules.description: Learn Workplace compensation structures, applicable laws, total rewards, payroll, data collections, work-life balance practices.

modules.title: Employee Relations
modules.description: Learn more about talent management, retention, attrition, employee relations programmes, ADR methods, employee offboarding, grievance management.

modules.title: Human Resources Development and Retention
modules.description: Understand retention strategies, workplace trainings, career development practices, performance appraisal.

modules.title: Nigerian Labour Law
modules.description: A practical grounding in Nigerian labour law essentials, covering employee rights, termination procedures, and the compliance obligations every employer needs to know.
